title: Zesty Light Jamaican Chicken Papillote
description: A winey and light Jamaican dish featuring unsweetened cocoa, perfect for a hangover cure, made with chicken cooked in a papillote with a blend of spices and herbs. This dish is nut-free-friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cocoa powder, olive oil, white wine, scotch bonnet peppers, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cut a large piece of parchment paper into a rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the chicken in the center of the parchment paper, leaving a 1-inch border around the chicken.
Fold the parchment paper over the chicken, creating a tight seal.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
